Owner.description:
What a secret belongs to: a tenant, and optionally one of its workspaces and a connection.

A secret is valid only within its owner: a tenant's in any of its workspaces, a workspace's
only in that workspace, a connection's only for that connection.

connection_id.description: The connection it belongs to, or None for none in particular.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

workspace_id.description: The workspace it belongs to, or None for the whole tenant.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

Owner.title: Owner

Reader.description:
Who reads a secret's value, as the audit records it: never the value.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the purpose isn't of :data:`PURPOSE`'s form.

component.description:
The component that reads it, such as ``egress``, ``credential-proxy`` or a connector's
follower.
component.title: Component

purpose.description: What it reads for; only a secret of the same purpose is read.
purpose.title: Purpose

scope.description:
Where it reads: the tenant, and the workspace and connection it acts for. A secret is read
only where this is within its owner.

session_id.description: The code session it reads for, if it reads for one.
session_id.title: Session Id

Reader.title: Reader

SecretMetadata.description: What may be listed of a secret: never its value.

current.description: The number of its current version.
current.title: Current

revoked_at.description: When it was revoked, if it was.
revoked_at.title: Revoked At

rotate_every.description: How often it is to be rotated, where its provider supports it.
rotate_every.title: Rotate Every

rotated_at.description: When it was last rotated, if it was.
rotated_at.title: Rotated At

SecretMetadata.title: SecretMetadata

SecretRef.description:
A reference to a secret, which everything but the store keeps instead of its value.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the id isn't of :data:`SECRET_ID`'s form or the purpose of
        :data:`PURPOSE`'s.

purpose.description: What it is for, such as ``forge:token``.
purpose.title: Purpose

SecretRef.title: SecretRef

SecretVersion.description: A version of a secret, as a rotation made it current.

number.description: Its number: the first value is 1, and each rotation adds one.
number.title: Number

previous_until.description: Until when the version before it stays readable, or None if there was none.
previous_until.title: Previous Until

SecretVersion.title: SecretVersion

description: lattice's secrets contract: `ref` is what everything but the store keeps, `reader` who reads a value, `version` what a rotation made current, and `metadata` what may be listed of a secret, never its value.
